mapper.select: SELECT m.id AS id, m.music_name AS musicName, m.album_id AS albumId, m.musician_id AS musicianId, m.cover_url AS coverUrl, m.bpm AS bpm, m.is_vip AS isVip, m.like_count AS likeCount, m.comment_count AS commentCount, m.duration AS duration, m.is_liked AS isLiked, al.album_name AS albumName, mu.stage_name AS musicianName FROM music m LEFT JOIN musician mu ON m.musician_id = mu.id LEFT JOIN album al ON m.album_id = al.id WHERE m.id = #{musicId}

SELECT m.id, m.music_name, m.cover_url, m.play_count, m.download_count, m.like_count, m.comment_count, m.create_time, mu.stage_name as musicianName FROM music m LEFT JOIN musician mu ON m.musician_id = mu.id WHERE m.play_count IS NOT NULL ORDER BY m.play_count DESC LIMIT 200

SELECT m.id AS id, m.music_name AS musicName, m.album_id AS albumId, m.musician_id AS musicianId, m.cover_url AS coverUrl, m.bpm AS bpm, m.is_vip AS isVip, m.like_count AS likeCount, m.comment_count AS commentCount, m.duration AS duration, al.album_name AS albumName, mu.stage_name AS musicianName FROM music m LEFT JOIN musician mu ON m.musician_id = mu.id LEFT JOIN album al ON m.album_id = al.id WHERE m.musician_id = #{musicianId}

SELECT m.id AS id, m.music_name AS musicName, m.cover_url AS coverUrl, m.bpm AS bpm, m.is_vip AS isVip, m.like_count AS likeCount, m.comment_count AS commentCount, m.duration AS duration, m.status AS status, al.album_name AS albumName, mu.stage_name AS musicianName, m.create_time AS createTime, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT mt.tag_name) AS tagName, ma.quality_type AS qualityType, ma.audio_url AS audioUrl, ma.file_size AS fileSize FROM music m LEFT JOIN musician mu ON m.musician_id = mu.id LEFT JOIN album al ON m.album_id = al.id LEFT JOIN music_tag_relation mtr ON m.id = mtr.music_id LEFT JOIN music_tag mt ON mtr.tag_id = mt.id LEFT JOIN music_audio_relation ma ON m.id = ma.music_id WHERE mu.user_id = #{musicianId} GROUP BY m.id, ma.quality_type
SELECT m.id FROM music_tag_relation t INNER JOIN music m ON t.music_id = m.id WHERE t.tag_id = #{tagId} AND m.id != #{currentMusicId} ORDER BY m.like_count DESC LIMIT 5
